questions.question: What is the safest way to travel on a slope?
options: Across the slope at speed
Straight up or down, with the attachment low
Diagonally with the bucket raised
It does not matter if the seatbelt is fastened
questions.explanation: Travelling straight up or down with a low attachment keeps the machine stable.

questions.question: A CRITICAL tilt alert appears. What does it mean?
options: The machine has reached its maximum safe tilt
The tilt sensor needs calibration
The machine is at 50% of its limit
The load is too light
questions.explanation: CRITICAL means 100% of the tilt limit. Stop and reduce the angle.

questions.question: Why should you keep back from trench edges?
options: To save fuel
The ground near the edge can collapse under the machine
Trench edges block the proximity sensor
It is only a rule for wheel loaders
questions.explanation: The edge carries the most load and is the most likely part of the ground to give way.

questions.question: Visibility drops below 50 m in fog. What should you do?
options: Continue at normal speed
Turn off work lights to reduce glare
Slow down, and stop if you cannot see the work area or your spotter
Rely only on the proximity sensor
questions.explanation: Low visibility needs slower work and more distance. Stop if you cannot see clearly.

questions.question: Which is a sign of heat stress?
options: Feeling dizzy or confused
Feeling hungry
Cold hands
Improved concentration
questions.explanation: Dizziness and confusion are warning signs. Stop, cool down, drink water, and tell your supervisor.
